channel.title: Go-Adk-2 on 梦兽编程
channel.description: Recent content in Go-Adk-2 on 梦兽编程

item.title: Module 10: Production Hardening (ADK Go 2.x)
item.description: agentregistry with authn/authz, the plugin system and OpenTelemetry observability, the capstone and evaluation strategy (including the fact that there is no eval package on the Go side)

item.title: Module 9: A2A and Cross-Language Interoperability (ADK Go 2.x)
item.description: server/adka2a and the v2 protocol implementation, remoteagent for consuming remote agents, the agent card origin pinning fix, and version alignment with the Python/Java/Kotlin/TypeScript ADKs

item.title: Module 8: Deployment and Operations (ADK Go 2.x)
item.description: adkgo deploy (cloudrun/agentengine), containerisation, the web launcher with pubsub/eventarc triggers, the prod launcher, and how authentication lands

item.title: Module 7: Streaming and Multimodal (ADK Go 2.x)
item.description: SSE and event streams, partial event handling, two-way audio (bidi/live), streaming function tools, and Chat UI integration

item.title: Module 6: New Multi-Agent Patterns (ADK Go 2.x)
item.description: The new behaviour of the workflowagents trio on top of the graph engine, plus llmagent's chat/task/single_turn collaboration modes and structured input/output

item.title: Module 5: The Graph Workflow Engine (core of ADK Go 2.x)
item.description: A complete tour of the workflow package: node types, Chain/EdgeBuilder/fan-out-join, routing, concurrent scheduling with per-node retry and timeouts, and HITL pause/resume with dynamic graphs

item.title: Module 4: Sessions, Events and Context Compaction (ADK Go 2.x)
item.description: The session/state trio, NewEvent(ctx) and platform providers, session/compaction context compression and recall, and the database session service

item.title: Module 3: The Tool System (ADK Go 2.x)
item.description: functiontool and streaming function tools, the MCP toolset, tool confirmation for human approval, and the SkillToolset skill directory

item.title: Module 2: The Core Object Model (ADK Go 2.x)
item.description: The unified agent.Context, platform providers, Hello World and gemini.NewModel(ctx), the launcher family and how you actually run an agent

item.title: Module 1: Environment and Project Layout (ADK Go 2.x)
item.description: Setting up ADK Go v2.4.0: go get adk/v2, the adkgo CLI, credential configuration, how the launcher runs, and the /v2-era go.mod and directory conventions

item.title: Module 0: Versioning and Migration (ADK Go 2.x)
item.description: The ADK Go 2.0 change map, hands-on 1.x→2.x migration, and why the toolchain floor is Go 1.26.6+

item.title: Go ADK 2.0 in Practice: The Complete Guide (ADK Go v2)
item.description: A brand-new series built on Google ADK Go v2.4.0: the graph workflow engine, collaboration modes, the unified agent.Context, built-in human-in-the-loop, SkillToolset, and context compaction. 31 articles, from zero to production.
